description: This PHP file defines the 'Logical' class which provides deprecated static methods for common logical operations and constants used within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation engine. It acts as a wrapper redirecting calls to newer classes, facilitating backward compatibility for Excel logical functions.

classes.name: Logical
classes.description: A deprecated class providing static methods for basic logical operations and functions as a backward-compatible interface for Excel logical functions within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: true
methods.description: Returns the boolean TRUE, delegating to Boolean::true().

methods.name: false
methods.description: Returns the boolean FALSE, delegating to Boolean::false().

methods.name: logicalAnd
methods.description: Returns the logical AND of arguments, delegating to Logical\Operations::logicalAnd().

methods.name: logicalOr
methods.description: Returns the logical OR of arguments, delegating to Logical\Operations::logicalOr().

methods.name: logicalXor
methods.description: Returns the logical XOR of arguments, delegating to Logical\Operations::logicalXor().

methods.name: NOT
methods.description: Returns the inverse of the logical value, delegating to Logical\Operations::NOT().

methods.name: statementIf
methods.description: Performs a conditional check, delegating to Logical\Conditional::statementIf().

methods.name: statementSwitch
methods.description: Returns a value based on matching an expression, delegating to Logical\Conditional::statementSwitch().

methods.name: IFERROR
methods.description: Returns the value if no error, or a specified error part if there is an error, delegating to Logical\Conditional::IFERROR().

methods.name: IFNA
methods.description: Returns the value if not an #N/A error, or a specified value if it is, delegating to Logical\Conditional::IFNA().

methods.name: IFS
methods.description: Performs multiple condition checks, delegating to Logical\Conditional::IFS().
